title: The Armstrong tribute and the Rotterdam trip with Dizzy, Carmen and Brubeck
summary: She and Dance date the Armstrong tribute to 1975 and the Rotterdam trip to 1976, with Dizzy Gillespie, Carmen McRae, Dave Brubeck, Wild Bill Davis, Floyd Smith and Buddy Rich.
